about_md:
I graduated from Politeknik Negeri Semarang with a degree in Computer Engineering Technology (GPA 3.84, cum laude). I build backend systems used in day-to-day operations.

At PT Indosat Ooredoo Hutchison (Circle Java), I worked on field-sales backends in FastAPI and Laravel for up to 500 active users. I also built WhatsApp and Telegram chatbots that send daily reports on outlet performance.

My projects include FTTH sales-data checks using YOLO26 and PaddleOCR, a PySpark pipeline that predicts drinking-water quality from 1.2 million rows, and an ESP32 soil-monitoring device. I focus on replacing repetitive manual work with processes teams can track and verify.
headline: Software Engineer & Backend Developer
summary_short: Software engineer focused on backend systems, APIs, data, and applied AI.
tagline: I build software that replaces repetitive manual work.
